objective: A round whose diff hash equals the previous round does not call the critic again; a hash that is absent or invalid never skips the critic.

criteria.text: Two equal valid hashes mean the diff is unchanged
An absent, short or upper case hash never means unchanged

fails: the critic skipped on an invalid hash; the critic called again on an equal diff; a regression
env: Node 24 and the standard library; the proof runs with node --test in a copy of this folder
output: the verdict of the critic on the issue
